description: Chapter 15.1 (v3.0) gives India 8 paid sick days, below the 10-day global minimum in Chapter 37.1; circular HR-CIR-2026-12 states the global floor applies, so India employees are entitled to 10 days.
Manual v3.0 sets the India night shift allowance at ₹600 per night; HR-CIR-2026-14 raises it to ₹700 only from 1 January 2027.
UK annual leave is 25 days in v3.0; HR-CIR-2026-15 raises it to 27 days from 1 January 2027.
Netherlands annual leave is 25 days in v3.0; HR-CIR-2026-19 raises it to 26 days from 1 January 2027.
Singapore employer CPF top-up rises from 17% to 18% only from 1 April 2027 (HR-CIR-2026-16).
FAQ-IN-COUNTRY states 7 days of paternity leave (v2.0 value); v3.0 and HR-CIR-2025-05 give 10 working days.
FAQ-HYBRID still says hybrid employees attend 2 office days a week; HR-CIR-2026-04 and v3.0 require 3 days from 1 April 2026.
The London office handbook says UK employees receive 23 days' annual leave (v1.0 value); v3.0 gives 25.
The Pune office handbook lists a ₹500 night shift allowance (v2.0 value); v3.0 gives ₹600.
The Singapore benefits summary says 16 days' annual leave (v2.0 value); v3.0 and HR-CIR-2025-04 give 18.
Hybrid office days: 2 (v1.0, v2.0) vs 3 (v3.0). Legitimate update, not a conflict.
Work from another country: not permitted (v1.0), 10 days (v2.0), 20 days (v3.0). Legitimate update.
